title: SourceSegment
description: A specific excerpt/time-range within one ResearchSource. Every StrategyAssertion cites the exact segment it was drawn from, not just the source as a whole, so provenance stays precise even within a long video or document.

timestampStart.description: Video/audio offset (e.g. '00:12:34') or null for non-timed sources (articles, notes).

rawExcerpt.description: The exact language from the source -- never paraphrased at this level.
